tenderSchedule.title: Repair and rewinding of 2 no. of 75HP induction motors of Gov. & MIV OPUs of Stage-1 Units-VUGPH
tenderSchedule.description: Repair and rewinding of 2 no. of 75HP induction motors of Gov. & MIV OPUs of Stage-1 Units-VUGPH. Detailed scope of work is contained in Section 7 of the tender document.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Turbine Office SVP VARAHI

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of all relevant documents as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular contractor/ authorized agency/firm that has carried out at least one similar work related to repair/rewinding/re-insulation of motors of 50HP above capacity in Govt. organizations/Public Sector Undertakings/Reputed organizations, in the preceding 5 financial years in any industry/ utility in India. In proof Bidder shall furnish work order copy of a single work carried out by the bidder, of value not less than Rs. 0.83 Lakh along with corresponding work done certificate issued from the competent authority (Work done amounts of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- work order copy of a single work of value not less than Rs. 0.83 Lakh along with corresponding work done certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have achieved a minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs.01.65 Lakh in any two financial years in the preceding five completed financial years, i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. (Financial turnover of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level). In proof Annual Report/turn over certificates/ profit and loss statement duly certified by Chartered accountant shall be furnished.
